name: Simple OAuth Redirect URI Wildcard
description: Allows wildcard redirect URIs in Simple OAuth. Implemented defensively (anchored regex, preg_quote, * matches a single subdomain label with no dots, and the wildcard is forbidden in the registrable-domain/TLD position) — but wildcard redirect URIs INHERENTLY weaken OAuth's exact-match requirement (OAuth2 Security BCP). Only use where you control ALL matching subdomains (beware subdomain takeover); prefer exact URIs.
